instrument_note: Reference chart and right-side execution tape remain separate. Exact chart levels are not execution-order prices unless basis is checked.
state: Price DOWN + CVD UP + OI FLAT/SLIGHTLY DOWN
path_note: After the multi-stage deleveraging cascade, CVD recovered from ~49.53B to ~50.23B while OI stopped collapsing near ~18.21B, but price still finished lower and remained well below dVAL/dOpen/dPOC. The intrawindow chart shows a rebound from a lower wick, but no structural reclaim of value.
interpretation: This is an early improvement in aggressive buy flow, but the price response is still weak. Because CVD rises while price remains lower and OI is flat/slightly lower, buyers may be getting absorbed by passive sellers. This is less bearish than renewed Price DOWN + CVD DOWN + OI UP, but it is not yet a long signal. The key question is whether improved CVD can finally force price back through dVAL and dOpen.

long_scenario.first_trigger: Reclaim dVAL ~78,522 and hold above it while CVD stays stable/up.
long_scenario.second_trigger: Reclaim dOpen ~78,550 and maintain positive price response; OI can be flat or rise moderately if price also advances.
long_scenario.safer_trigger: Reclaim dPOC ~78,768 with acceptance/retest from above.
long_scenario.reason: CVD improvement without price reclaim is buyer effort, not proof of control.

risk_scenario.warning: If CVD rolls back over and price loses the current rebound while OI turns UP, bearish leverage-expansion risk returns immediately.
risk_scenario.stronger_warning: Acceptance toward/through pDay Low ~77,600 with CVD down and OI up would invalidate the early buyer-improvement read.

lesson: After a prolonged Price DOWN + CVD DOWN + OI DOWN deleveraging cascade, the first transition to Price DOWN + CVD UP + OI FLAT/SLIGHTLY DOWN is only an early buyer-effort signal. Do not call a bottom from CVD alone. Require price to reclaim value in sequence: dVAL -> dOpen -> dPOC. If price cannot respond to improving CVD, treat it as buyer failure/passive-seller absorption rather than bullish confirmation.
